title: Light travels. Knowledge survives.
subtitle: For generations, stars helped people orient across distance and time. Their light arrives carrying information from elsewhere and earlier.
socialSubtitle: Stars orient. Their light carries information across distance and time.
socialDetail: A name for durable intelligence, not a product claim.
detail: The name is a direction for the work: help useful intelligence survive changing tools, teams, and ventures.
diagramAlt: An observation axis marks orientation and arrival. Starlight is a metaphor for information crossing distance and time, not a present space technology claim.
